Holistic Wellness
Your daily companion for living with intention — tracking what nourishes your body, moves you forward, restores your sleep, and grounds you in faith and peace.
HOW IT WORKS
Everything lives in six simple modules — Workout, Nutrition, Sleep, Weight, Spirituality & Peace, and Wellness Trends. Log a little in whichever one fits your moment; they all feed into each other. Visit the Content Library anytime to make the workouts, meals, and philosophy your own.

✏️ Philosophy Editor
📖 Personal Philosophy Statement
This appears in your daily rotating quotes and full statement view.
Tip: Each sentence becomes a separate daily rotating quote. Put each meaningful sentence on its own line for best results.
✨ Suggested Reflection Prompts
Generated from your philosophy statement. Check the ones you like — they're added to the Prayer & Reflection Prompts box below, but nothing is saved until you tap "Save Prompts" there.
🙏 Prayer & Reflection Prompts
These appear in the Return to Center prayer tab. One prompt per line.
🙏 Weekly Gratitude Prompts
One of these is asked each week on your Spirituality & Peace screen. One prompt per line.

🗂️ Content Library
Everything here shapes what the app offers — workouts, meals, and philosophy. It's kept completely separate from your personal tracking history, so you can freely rearrange, rename, or hide content without affecting a single logged workout, meal, or entry.

Used by the Nutrition Tracker to show your daily progress
